description_zh: 调用ListOIDCProviders查询OIDC身份提供商列表
name: ListOIDCProviders

parameters.help_en: The `marker`. If part of a previous response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the truncated part
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be `true`.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于`true`。
 
取值范围：1~100。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_items

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the response is truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

Marker.description_en: The `marker`. This parameter is returned only if the value of `IsTruncated` is `true`. If the parameter is returned, you can call this operation again and set this parameter to obtain the truncated part.\`\`
Marker.description_zh: 当`IsTruncated`为`true`时才有此参数，当返回`true`时，需要继续调用该接口，并且使用`Marker`获取截断后的内容

OIDCProvider.description_en: The information about the OIDC IdP

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC IdP

ClientIds.description_en: The ID of the client, If you want to specify multiple client IDs, separate the client IDs with commas (,)
ClientIds.description_zh: 客户端ID。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was created. The time is displayed in UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the OIDC IdP
Description.example: This is a new OIDC Provider.

Fingerprints.description_en: The fingerprint of the HTTPS certificate. If multiple fingerprints are returned, the fingerprints are separated by commas (,)
Fingerprints.description_zh: HTTPS CA证书的验证指纹。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the OIDC IdP was created

GmtModified.description_en: The timestamp when the OIDC IdP was modified

IssuanceLimitTime.description_en: The earliest time when an external IdP can issue an ID token. If the value of the iat field in the ID token is later than the current time, the request is rejected. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168
IssuanceLimitTime.description_zh:
允许外部IdP颁发ID Token的最早签发时间。ID Token中的iat字段如果距离当前时间大于这个值则请求会被拒绝。
单位：小时。取值范围：1~168

OIDCProviderName.description_en: The name of the OIDC IdP

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was modified. The time is displayed in UTC
